usedFor: Copper holds opportunities, and Freshsales Classic holds the deals “Update Deal” changes after “Opportunity Deleted”.

bestTemplate.name: “Opportunity Deleted” in Copper, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A deleted opportunity can set the matching deal's stage, so the two CRMs agree.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds the deal by ID or name, so “Opportunity Deleted” must pass one of them.
